ref_entities: test the cache_iterator function to verify it returns cached values from a source iterator
test cache_iterator with return_caches_after parameter to verify cached values are returned after a threshold
test cache_iterator with stop_after parameter to verify iteration stops after a specified number of items
test the CacheDataLoader class to verify it wraps a data loader with caching and replay behavior
run the unit tests for CacheDataLoader and cache_iterator to validate caching iterator functionality
test the DataLoader class by iterating over a list of integers and verifying sorted output
test the DataLoader preprocessor parameter by applying a doubling function to each item in the source
test the DataLoader output_order parameter to verify input order preservation versus completion order
test the DataLoader batch_size and drop_last parameters to verify batching behavior with and without dropping
test the DataLoader aggregator parameter by applying a statistics function to each batch of items
test MergeIterator to merge multiple iterables in round-robin order
test MergeIterator with stop_after parameter to limit yielded items
test MergeIterator with weighted probabilities to prioritize certain iterables
test repeat_source to repeat an iterable source across multiple epochs
test embed_shuffle to shuffle an iterable source with seed-based randomization
test DistributedDeterministicSampler to verify it produces sequential indices matching range(N) for a given rank and world size
test DistributedRandomSampler shuffle method to verify different indices are generated each epoch using a seed parameter
test DistributedRandomSampler with custom weights to verify indices are drawn proportionally according to weight distribution
test embed_shuffle utility to verify it produces identical shuffled results as calling shuffle on DistributedRandomSampler manually
test iterate_in_subprocess with embed_shuffle to verify subprocess iteration produces identical results to main process iteration
test the LocalDirectory source to traverse files matching a glob pattern in a directory
test the ImageNet source to return image paths and class IDs for train or val splits
test the SourceTest class to verify shuffle method randomizes file iteration order
run the SourceTest unit tests to validate LocalDirectory and ImageNet source behaviors
review the SourceTest class and its test methods for LocalDirectory and ImageNet sources
test embed_shuffle to verify it calls shuffle with incrementing seeds before each iteration
test embed_shuffle behavior when an iterator is deleted mid-iteration and recreated
test embed_shuffle with shuffle_last=True to defer shuffle until after iteration completes
test embed_shuffle with shuffle_last=True when iteration is halted mid-way through
review the IterableWithShuffle_ helper class that implements __iter__ and shuffle for testing
